@graph.name: 3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: We really enjoyed the weekend! We did the midnight tour, the volcanos were amazing and we had so much fun! Our guide Adi was really nice and despite some language problems sometimes, he was really helpful. And prior to the tour, Sam was very helpful to answer all our questions. Be careful, even if that is not specific to this tour, there is a lot of transportation hours during the weekend (we spent 16 hours in the car in total in only two days). Our only regret is that we had a friend who couldn't do the trek part after he had a pain in the leg, and our guide told us he would arrange for him to join us in Bromo, and in fact it could have been absolutely feasible to pick him with a motorbike. Instead he had to stay in the car for 5 hours. Same for the next day, it could have been possible to pick him and go to the hot springs. Another negative point is the dinner on Saturday night which was disappointing and too small after a big day of activity, and that no food is offered on Sunday after the trek.
